info.name: Retrieve sports by ID/s. MAX 200 per page.

params.name: page
params.description: The number of page to be returned. The default value is 1.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The size of the page to be returned. The default value is 10.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to 'order by' by. Descending ordering also allowed. Fields to order by for this endpoint: (id, name)

params.name: filter
params.description: The field to 'filter' by. Check main description for filter comparators. Fields to filter by for this endpoint: (id, name)

items.docs: Returns sports wrapped inside a HATEOAS model

info.name: Retrieve allowed properties per entity type name and per sport.

params.name: entityType
params.description: Entity type is the name of the entity for which the allowed properties will be retrieved. Entity types: competition, competitor, contract, fixture, round, season, venue, fixtureperson, player, team

params.name: id
params.description: The sport for which the allowed properties will be retrieved.
